summary: Round 12, focus = private-read calibration and lessons. Honest answer: no new mechanism reaches R8 (27 Sep 12:00 UTC); nothing here touches the finals #37 + #38 and nothing needs a slot. Four zero-cost items: (1) a CONFOUND the 16:04 PRIVATE-READ PREDICTIONS missed: #35's latency (6.72, 7.73] h means x138's own 7.5 h repair deadline may have degraded #35, so C1 (#35-#34) and C4 (P36-#35) carry a one-sided bias (a degrade can only LOWER #35), while C2 (#37-#38) and C3 (#38-#34) are clean and C3 = lowrefine alone (no deadline fired in either file). (2) A pre-registered outcome table O-A..O-E + C3/C4 rules with the post-deadline items each outcome promotes or kills, using the exact rule that a non-zero displayed difference has the sign of the true difference (rounding is monotone) and a displayed 0 is uninformative. (3) An exact reading procedure: API private_score is a 3-decimal STRING (checked read-only now; no unrounded field), rank from the private LB CSV, medal lines from N, a sub-display read of max(#37,#38) vs X from our position inside the X block (ties go to the earlier submission, so ranking above earlier copies at the same display proves unrounded > X), public LB snapshot at 29 Sep ~23:30Z, two reads (first publication and after Kaggle's cleanup). (4) Twelve precise LESSONS_draft text fixes (R11-A7 s4 lines never landed; combo-oracle numbers absent; s5 forbids the rank read that I-094 asks for; stale counts; the orphan-attach adder omitted). One new post-deadline item: a late-submission factorial (if Kaggle enables late submissions) with the already-built K1 exp58t to remove the #35 confound, and the private split as the multi-embryo gate the lab never had; needs the user's OK per submission.

P36 (L36_hi 7.42 h), #34 (<= 6.46 h), K2 (7.36-7.54 h vs a 9.5 h deadline and 8.0 h insertion gate, clean) and the twin (6.69-6.87 h, 9.5 h deadline) are clean. The hidden rerun covers public + private in ONE run, so the same degrade (if any) sits in #35's private score. A degrade can only LOWER #35: it biases C1 down and C4 = P36 - #35 up. C2 and C3 are clean; C3 = #38 - #34 is lowrefine ALONE (safetail acts only when a deadline fires, and none fired in either file). Consequence: C1 > 0 is a clean positive read; C1 <= 0 is ambiguous (insertion harm OR #35 degrade); C4 <= 0 is a clean 'leaf prune does not help' read; C4 > 0 is ambiguous. The four numbers cannot separate degrade from stack interaction: with C5 = #37 - #35, C5 - C3 = C2 - C1 identically.

findings.what: PRE-REGISTERED OUTCOME TABLE for 30 Sep (calibration only, never a finals input). Units: thousandths of the displayed private scores, k(f) = round(1000 x private_score(f)). Exact sign rule: rounding is monotone, so a non-zero displayed difference has the sign of the true difference; a displayed 0 means only |true| < 0.001. O-A: C1 > 0 and C2 > 0 -> the insertion transfers to the private embryos on both stacks -> PROMOTE post-deadline item 6 (far-daughter slot / I-079 division work; target a fork/orphan classifier at AUC ~0.94 with an embryo-held-out gate) to first place; 'separate-evidence networks transfer' becomes a confirmed lesson (it does not confirm the ~1/6 size rule). O-B: C2 > 0, C1 = 0 -> clean insertion gain on the K2 stack, C1 unresolved (rounding or #35 degrade) -> as O-A but weaker; R12P-5 is the tie-breaker. O-C: C1 = C2 = 0 -> uninformative (true private delta < 0.001 on ~71% of the test) -> no promotion; item 6 keeps its bar (lab >= +0.012). O-D: C2 < 0 (any C1) -> the insertion hurt the private embryos on our finals stack -> DEMOTE item 6 (only with an unseen-embryo gate); lesson 'public +0.001 on one embryo was embryo-specific'; if also C1 >= 0: STACK INTERACTION (a #35 degrade cannot produce C1 > C2) -> lesson 'test riders on the final stack', lowrefine suspect. O-E: C1 < 0 <= C2 (or C1 < C2 generally) -> #35 degrade OR interaction, not separable from these numbers -> runtime-headroom lesson (safetail's deadline headroom may have mattered); resolve only by R12P-5. C3 rule: C3 = 0 -> lowrefine neutral as designed. C3 > 0 -> refining the low-det pool with V1284 transfers -> PROMOTE items 2-3 (axial localisation, learned z correction). C3 < 0 -> 'node-neutral by design' was not score-neutral: our F2 sat below the x138 floor -> lesson 'every rider needs a lab arm, even a harmless-looking one'; demote lowrefine-type riders. C4 rule: C4 <= 0 -> leaf prune closed for good (also on private); C4 > 0 -> ambiguous (leaf prune or #35 degrade), no promotion. Team result = max(k37, k38); the forecast P(max > X) 0.85-0.9 is read in R12P-3.

findings.what: RANK-VS-FORECAST CALIBRATION with a sub-display read. Forecast (CONTEXT 16:54 UTC): ~250-400 teams above us -> rank ~251-401, central ~320; P(bronze or better) 0.65-0.7, P(silver) 0.10-0.15, P(no medal) ~0.3. Read: (a) X_disp = k(#34); count of teams with private display > X_disp. (b) SUB-DISPLAY: if max(k37, k38) = X_disp, our position inside the X_disp block decides the sign: ties go to the EARLIER submission and ~240+ exact x138 copies were submitted before our 26 Sep 00:02Z files, so ranking above an earlier-submitted team at the same display proves our unrounded max > its unrounded score (for exact copies: > X); ranking below all of them means <= X. (c) Copy-block coherence: fraction of teams at public 0.953 on the final public snapshot whose private display = X_disp (tests 'exact copies share one private X'; < ~0.8 falsifies it, e.g. GPU nondeterminism across accounts). (d) Public-margin retention: for teams at public 0.955-0.957, median (private - X_priv) / (public - 0.953) against the modelled 0.3-0.5, and the fraction still above X_disp. (e) Our rank R vs [251, 401]. Readings: R in range -> forecast calibrated; R < 251 -> public-tuned variants kept less than 0.3 of their margin (larger shake-up than modelled); R > 401 with max > X -> the crowd above kept more margin or the >= 0.954 group outgrew 450-550; R > ~650 -> both finals <= X (the modelled no-medal branch). The medal outcome is one Bernoulli draw against P(no medal) ~0.3: report it, derive no rule from it.

findings.what: EXACT READING PROCEDURE (30 Sep). (1) Before: 29 Sep ~23:00-23:45 UTC save the final PUBLIC LB (`python -m kaggle competitions leaderboard biohub-cell-tracking-during-development -d`, read-only) to experiments/private_read/20260929T23xxZ_public_lb.zip, plus a submissions CSV. (2) From 30 Sep 00:15 UTC, hourly until all five refs have a non-empty private score: KaggleApi().competition_submissions('biohub-cell-tracking-during-development') -> private_score (a 3-decimal STRING, '' until published; verified read-only on 26 Sep: public_score '0.953'/'0.954'; no unrounded field exists) for 56545267 (#34), 56545786 (#35), 56555189 (P36), 56563521 (#37), 56563534 (#38); cross-check with `python -m kaggle competitions submissions biohub-cell-tracking-during-development -v` (CSV column privateScore) called directly, not via poll.log (the poller keeps only the first 60 lines). Log `date -u` at first sight. (3) Rank: download the LB CSV again after close; VERIFY it is the private board (our team's Score = max(k37, k38)/1000; if it still shows 0.954 while max(k37,k38) != 954, it is the public board -> read the Private tab in the browser, read-only). Rank = the board's own order (exact ties already ordered by submit time). (4) Medal lines for N >= 1000 teams: gold top 10 + floor(0.002 N), silver top 5%, bronze top 10% (~17 / ~197 / ~395 at ~3,950). (5) Compute C1..C4, C5 = #37 - #35 and I = C2 - C1 in thousandths; apply R12P-1/R12P-2 mechanically. (6) Re-read rank and N after Kaggle's post-competition cleanup (disqualifications, e.g. leaked-CSV users, can move ranks for days); report both, calibrate on the first. (7) Fill the LESSONS s5 table and append to CONTEXT section 11.
